description: A guard that rejects calls to a failing dependency so failures do not spread and the service can recover.
The state in which calls are rejected immediately without reaching the dependency.
The state that allows a few trial calls to decide whether the dependency has recovered.
A degraded but acceptable result returned when the call fails or the circuit is open.
Repeating only operations that are safe to repeat, such as calls carrying an idempotency key.
A limit on concurrent calls to one dependency so a slow service cannot use all threads.
